entries.note: KEY FINDING for the Category-field investigation task: the top-level Global Option 'Category' field (global_option_category_id) is a SEPARATE, currently-empty concept (0 categories exist for Global Option itself — the create form's Category picker showed literal 'No category' with zero options). But the 'Additional Option' layer type ALSO has its own type-specific field 'Select additional options category', whose picker listed REAL category names ('QA CTX06 ReCheck AddOpt', 'QA CTX06 AddOpt 01', 'QA AddOpt Cat') that read like leftovers from the earlier asset-category run CTX-20260910-06. Selecting one wrote data.additional_option = 6009 (a raw numeric id) into the Global Option's 'data' JSON blob — same id-range as the additional-option category ids referenced in asset-category evidence (6008/6009/6010 region). OBSERVATION ONLY: this strongly suggests data.additional_option references the same underlying additional-option category table used by /additional-options, but the exact FK/table has not been confirmed via schema/DB — hand off to api-explorer/db-explorer to verify, do not treat as confirmed.
